headline: IMF Approves $425 Million Economic and Financial Program for Guinea
summary: The International Monetary Fund approved a $425 million economic and financial program for Guinea to support structural reforms and national macroeconomic stability.
why: The IMF provides financial assistance to developing economies to reinforce fiscal and monetary policies.

impacts.name: Guinea
impacts.why: Guinea received IMF approval for a $425 million economic support program.
